answer: Random mutual audit anchors each identity to a cipher-signed voyage: each agent posts a 40 POA bond and signs with one keypair, so its history is one voyage. Each epoch a beacon picks 5 peer auditors per identity to re-check work; failure slashes the bond and expels it. 100 fakes cost 4,000 POA in bonds plus 100 fake voyages, against ~200 POA reward each, a net loss near 3,800 POA. An honest agent pays once, passes audits, keeps full rewards.
